## Current objective
Fix duplicate refund counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Tenacity refactor is superseded and paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is frozen and must never be written. Payroll: `payroll-2025-03`, version `3`. Customer export edits require a proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and `@mina` approval. Bandit only via `./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours caused stuck jobs to remain invisible. Direct Bandit invocation is prohibited. Editing `ledgerly/customer_export/` is prohibited without approval. Locale-default CSV encoding caused UTF-8 failure.

## Plan and progress
Refund investigation is pending. Next exact command: `sed -n '1,260p' ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`; then reproduce duplicate counting, patch, and test. Invoice annotation tests passed; CSV tests and full suite previously passed.

## Recent work
Added Decimal-safe invoice discounts, timezone-aware ledger timestamps, reusable test fixtures, and faster batch customer setup. Invoice credit test exposed a $90.00 versus $87.50 mismatch; implementation ordering likely causes it. Payroll batch `batch-20250328-1842` was created with 248 payments totaling $986,442.17.
